title_o: Perseverance in self-perception and social perception: biased attributional processes in the debriefing paradigm

replications.quote: Subjects' initial assessments of their persuasive ability persisted after the evidential value of apparent success or failure upon which these impressions were based was fully discredited.
the perseverance effect that occurs after standard outcome debriefing is limited to perceptions of specific task-relevant skills rather than more global abilities
